requirement_vague: Verify unfollow removes follow relationship and updates profile following status

omissions.description: DELETE /api/profiles/{username}/follow does not reject self-unfollow with 400.
omissions.reasoning: The requirement says a user cannot unfollow themselves and the request should return 400. In unfollow_user, the code looks up the target and deletes any FollowLink if present, then always returns 200 with the profile. There is no check for current_user.id == target.id and no 400 response.
